paragraphs: SymPro sells treasury software for the public sector, covering investment, debt and cash accounting operations. The investment product provides investment portfolio accounting, reporting and analysis, and the pages state that it is GASB 31 compliant. Debt Manager creates a library of information on outstanding obligations for issuers. The Cash Management solution is a web-based system for public entities to manage and control their cash operations.

The about page counts more than 400 clients nationwide, with investment, debt and cash portfolios from 25 million to several billion dollars. Clients named on the home page include Snohomish County, Walla Walla County Treasurer and Whatcom County Treasurer's Office. The home page also lists over 50 standard reports covering performance, interest, portfolio analysis and compliance.

The about page dates the company to 1985 and to public sector financial experts in the SF Bay Area. Emphasys acquired SymPro from JP Morgan Chase & Co. in 2007, and Emphasys Software is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc.

quote.text: For over 30 years, Public Sector entities have depended on SymPro Solutions for their treasury management software.
